notes: Ready for review; not deployed or pushed.
Plain HTML, CSS, vanilla JS, Vite; all six sections implemented. Google Fonts loaded successfully.
The binary map and exact particle coordinates were referenced but absent from the supplied prompt. Reconstructed a 28-column/10-row map and 10 cube fragments plus 4 dots within the specified ranges.
Only the Nimbus Grid visual reference was inspected. No screenshot/video used as page content; no extracted bitmap assets.
Dashboard is a fictional console preview; New pool replays its confirmation. Plan CTAs navigate within the page. Monthly prices show an explicit 1 TiB estimate.
No agents, other sessions, deployment, push, or external messages. All generated files are inside this project. node_modules removed; dependency lock retained.
Browser testing validates and captures the live shader, then removes its iframe from the temporary test page to free software WebGL resources for subsequent checks.

Supplemental mobile platform screenshots were recaptured without GPU rendering after a headless software-WebGL capture glitch. Hero screenshots retain the live shader; details and repeat command are in README.md.
